prerequisite: The drawing already has a design TIN (built manually from feature lines or produced by create_dredge_grading) and an existing-ground TIN; run list_surfaces first to get the names
fixture_requirements: Design and existing surfaces overlap over a large area in plan
The design surface has both areas below existing (true cut) and areas above existing (existing kept); both are needed so a zero-difference line can be extracted
The existing surface has breakline structure at steep banks (verifies edge sampling hugs them; a blind grid fails here)
The design surface partly exceeds the existing surface extent (verifies the off_existing branch)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg; headless apply:true throws eFilerError, so save-as plus swap (see the accoreconsole-limits note)
post-dredge surface = min(design, existing): at any point the post elevation == the lower of the two (within TIN interpolation error)
verify hard assertion 1: existing vs post fill_residual is approximately 0 (min() is never above existing); fill_ratio > 0.5% must warn
verify hard assertion 2: cut_volume is approximately design_cut_volume (truth = cut side of existing vs design TIN overlay); deviation > 1% warns and names the truth field
SY1 baseline (2026-08-23, edge_step=2): true_cut=165207.6, post cut=166038 (+0.50%), fill=30.3 (0.018%); the false design fill of 90875 was correctly absorbed by the merge

Sampling strategy: inside a TIN facet any triangulation is exact; error only arises across edges -- sample along the edges of both surfaces subdivided by edge_step; a blind grid crossing steep banks amplifies noise instead (SY1 measured: no refinement 0.56%, 5 m blind grid 1.10%, 2 m blind grid 0.47%, 2 m edge sampling 0.018%)

Zero-difference line: extract the contour at epsilon (default 1 mm) on the cut side; segments shorter than min_crease_length are dropped and counted; written to crease_layer as 3D polylines (vertices on the existing surface) and added as breaklines to the post surface
Extent: the post-surface outer boundary = the largest ring of the design surface ExtractBorder; other rings are treated as Hide holes with a warning
All-cut or all-kept cases give 0 zero-difference lines: a warning suggests judging by the verify volumes; no throw

Idempotent: rerun with the same parameters; clear_existing clears only the post surface of the same name + zero-difference lines carrying C3DF_POSTDREDGE XData belonging to that out_surface + leftover temporary surfaces; user entities and other surfaces are untouched
Temporary surfaces (_C3DF_POST_TMPDIFF-* / verify-* / compare-*) are deleted once read; none remain in the final drawing (verify with list_surfaces)
out_surface equal to an input name, or design == existing, throws instead of failing silently
Design/existing that are not TIN surfaces throw and are named (this node reads vertices and triangles)
off_existing (design vertices where existing cannot be sampled) keep the design elevation and are counted; points where neither surface samples do not enter the surface

Headless iteration over Vertices/Triangles did not crash in this node (contrary to the hard-crash warning in the SurfaceStats comment; probably depends on surface state) -- if a crash reproduces on another drawing the symptom is a result stuck at ops:[]; suspect this first
With fill_residual > 1 m3, fill_hotspots is output (50 m cell aggregation, top 10, with zP/zE/zD criteria) to locate residual fill and its kind (zP between zE and zD = chord lifted across an edge)
The post surface is large: SY1 with 380k vertices grew the drawing from 14 MB to 43 MB; increase edge_step to trade accuracy for size
